description: Object inputs that gcs-mimic rejects as unsupported: a resource kind that is not storage#object and an empty custom metadata key on multipart insert and on PATCH, an X-Goog-Hash algorithm other than crc32c and md5 on a media upload, and predefinedAcl on PATCH. Checks SPEC-SDK-UNSUPPORTED.

steps.name: insert-wrong-kind
steps.body_text:
--gcsmimicdiff
Content-Type: application/json; charset=UTF-8

{{"name":"{object}-kind","kind":"storage#bucket"}}
--gcsmimicdiff
Content-Type: text/plain

x
--gcsmimicdiff--

steps.name: insert-empty-metadata-key
steps.body_text:
--gcsmimicdiff
Content-Type: application/json; charset=UTF-8

{{"name":"{object}-emptykey","metadata":{{"":"v"}}}}
--gcsmimicdiff
Content-Type: text/plain

x
--gcsmimicdiff--
